Paladin.description: Holy protector. Strong defense, blocking and sacred attacks.

nodes.name: Paladin Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +2. Holy Light: Restore 32 HP + healing bonus. Against undead, also deal 18 holy power damage. No weapon required.

nodes.name: Radiant Discipline
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +4. Judgment: Holy damage; base power +36. Deals 1.8x damage to undead enemies.

nodes.name: Dawn Avatar
nodes.description: Dawn Avatar: Holy damage; base power +55. Defense +12 for 3 rounds. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Ranger.description: Agile tracker. Marks targets and strengthens companion attacks.

nodes.name: Ranger Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +1. Seeking Arrow: Physical damage; base power +24. Cannot be dodged. Requires bow.

nodes.name: Hunter Precision
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +4. Hawkstrike: Wind damage; base power +36. Deals 1.75x damage to flying enemies. Requires bow.

nodes.name: Wild Hunt
nodes.description: Wild Hunt: Wind damage; base power +55. Deals 1.8x damage to beast enemies. Cannot be dodged. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Druid.description: Nature caster. Roots enemies and restores health over time.

nodes.name: Druid Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +3. Briarstorm: Nature damage; base power +24. 50% chance to root for one turn (bosses resist half).

nodes.name: Wild Renewal
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +4. Grove Renewal: Restore 60 HP + healing bonus and renew 12 HP for 4 rounds. Defense +5 for 4 rounds.

nodes.name: Ancient Grove
nodes.description: Ancient Grove: Restore 160 HP + healing bonus. Primary-class mythic only; learned with skill points, no level gate. Also restore 100 companion HP (does not revive).

Warrior.description: Physical specialist. Reliable defense and heavy weapon techniques.

nodes.name: Warrior Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +2. Cleave: Physical damage; base power +24. Enemy defense -4 for 3 rounds. Requires sword, greatsword, spear, axe, mace.

nodes.name: Veteran Strength
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +4. Veteran Assault: Physical damage; base power +36. 2 strikes at 62% power each; defense applies per strike. Bonus damage +16 against armor-broken or weakened targets. Requires sword, greatsword, spear, axe, mace.

nodes.name: Legendary Onslaught
nodes.description: Legendary Onslaught: Physical damage; base power +55. 4 strikes at 44% power each; defense applies per strike. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Barbarian.description: High HP and raw attack. Rage trades health for force.

nodes.name: Barbarian Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +2. Sundering Roar: A weapon-independent roar: sonic power 24 + 1.5 per hero level. Enemy defense -7 for three rounds. Costs 9 MP; no HP cost.

nodes.name: Blood Fury
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +4. Titan Swing: Physical damage; base power +36. Ignores 50% defense. Costs 8 HP (cannot self-KO). Requires axe, greatsword, hammer.

nodes.name: Worldbreaker
nodes.description: Worldbreaker: Physical damage; base power +65. Enemy defense -10 for 3 rounds. Ignores 100% defense. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Wizard.description: Arcane caster. Largest mana reserve and magical barriers.

nodes.name: Wizard Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +1. Arcane Barrage: Arcane damage; base power +24. 3 strikes at 48% power each; defense applies per strike.

nodes.name: Spell Scholar
nodes.description: Permanent: MP +8. Astral Rupture: Arcane damage; base power +36. Ignores 100% defense.

nodes.name: Arcane Cataclysm
nodes.description: Arcane Cataclysm: Arcane damage; base power +60. 3 strikes at 55% power each; defense applies per strike. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Sorcerer.description: Elemental attacker. Fire damage and freezing control.

nodes.name: Sorcerer Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: MP +7. Lightning Lance: Lightning damage; base power +24. 35% chance to stun for one turn (bosses resist half).

nodes.name: Wild Magic
nodes.description: Permanent: MP +10. Inferno: Fire damage; base power +36. Burn: 10 fire damage for 3 rounds.

nodes.name: Elemental Tempest
nodes.description: Elemental Tempest: Lightning damage; base power +65. Burn: 12 fire damage for 3 rounds. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Healer.description: Restoration specialist. Efficient healing and protective light.

nodes.name: Healer Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: MP +6. Greater Mending: Restore 65 HP + healing bonus. Defense +6 for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Restorative Grace
nodes.description: Permanent: HEALING +4. Sanctuary: Restore 100 HP + healing bonus. Defense +12 for 3 rounds. Also restore 40 companion HP (does not revive).

nodes.name: Miracle
nodes.description: Miracle: Restore 180 HP + healing bonus. Primary-class mythic only; learned with skill points, no level gate. Revive the active companion with 55 HP, or restore 55 companion HP.

Rogue.description: Evasive opportunist. Highest dexterity, feints and venom.

nodes.name: Rogue Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +3. Opportunist Strike: Physical damage; base power +24. Bonus damage +22 against marked, poisoned, bleeding or burning targets. Requires dagger, sword, bow.

nodes.name: Opportunist
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +4. Dancing Blades: Physical damage; base power +36. 3 strikes at 48% power each; defense applies per strike. Dexterity +8 for 2 rounds. Requires dagger, sword, bow.

nodes.name: Phantom Dance
nodes.description: Phantom Dance: Physical damage; base power +58. 3 strikes at 55% power each; defense applies per strike. Dexterity +20 for 3 rounds. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Assassin.description: Precision striker. Exploits marked and poisoned targets.

nodes.name: Assassin Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +2. Deathmark: Physical damage; base power +24. 1% instant KO on a landed hit. Bosses are immune; otherwise deals normal damage. Requires dagger, sword.

nodes.name: Lethal Precision
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +4. Eclipse Cut: Physical damage; base power +36. Ignores 25% defense. Bonus damage +30 when enemy HP is below 35%. Requires dagger, sword.

nodes.name: Nightfall
nodes.description: Nightfall: Shadow damage; base power +65. Bonus damage +35 against marked, poisoned, bleeding or burning targets. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Monk.description: Martial artist. Fists, agile combinations and meditation.

nodes.name: Monk Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: CRITICAL +2. Rising Palm: Physical damage; base power +24. 65% chance to stun for one turn (bosses resist half). Requires unarmed, claws, staff.

nodes.name: Focused Fist
nodes.description: Permanent: ATTACK +4. Hundred Fists: Physical damage; base power +36. 5 strikes at 32% power each; defense applies per strike. Requires unarmed, claws, staff.

nodes.name: Enlightenment
nodes.description: Enlightenment: Physical damage; base power +55. Ignores 100% defense. Defense +10 for 3 rounds. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.

Necromancer.description: Shadow caster. Life drain, curses and temporary spectral strikes.

nodes.name: Necromancer Arts
nodes.description: Permanent: HP +8. Soul Rend: Shadow damage; base power +24. Recover 5 MP on a hit.

nodes.name: Deathless Study
nodes.description: Permanent: MP +10. Grave Harvest: Shadow damage; base power +36. Restore 75% of damage dealt as HP. Bonus damage +20 when enemy HP is below 35%.

nodes.name: Requiem
nodes.description: Requiem: Shadow damage; base power +60. Restore 100% of damage dealt as HP. Primary-class mythic only; secondary unlocks stay saved.
